body:
Current weighted canonicalization still constructs general closure and per-state closed `BTreeMap`s in `src/cleanup_plan/replay/factored/canonical_shared.rs`. The single-epsilon alias and ephemeral singleton successor target are already present (#830/#831); this issue must preserve them. Each new key uses the current safe maximum std-tree node reservation. Changing that bound alone is not an optimization.

Implement real directly prepaid ordered storage for the numeric closure and closed accumulator, starting with an authenticated borrowed singleton closed view. Preserve the exact original traversal and work requests, numeric IDs, signatures, multiplicities, checked arithmetic and first overflow/refusal. General multi-input states must remain fully supported; no sparse-gap quadratic allocation. Keep complete independent old receivers and every source-history projection. State/signature dictionaries and persistent singleton target storage are later follow-ups if actual attribution warrants them.

Evidence: actual d6bf source `d6bf8151942190a956eb57350fa8b8892a8c68e5` still fails the unchanged production native/project primitive-string-codec owners at the 67,108,864-byte live builder cap, despite a ~13 MB forecast. The exact production inner operation is unknown. The 48,840,045-byte trace in the separate library witness is **aggregate final-HIR validation spend including a test-only oracle**, not cleanup-only spend or a document_end allocation. Current-source discovery at b3e4e2b71 identifies remaining constructions, not measured savings. No cap recovery or token advantage is established.

Acceptance: source/compiler/contract updates as applicable; complete old/current closure and canonical receiver parity across diamonds/cycles/duplicates/sinks/mixed moves/weighted overflow; original work frontiers; actual cold reservation/allocation/peak/full-Drop observations, zero/exact/one-short growth and foreign/stale/sticky refusal; full source inverses with all old hooks retained. Run only the exact new/affected owning checks plus unchanged #808 production integration and builder recovery selectors at the large-batch boundary, and scoped Clippy. Never run full suites/gates. Keep actual allocation separate from reservation. Report any remaining #808 failure honestly; only matched live agent runs can establish token/turn improvements. No cap increase, rebate/refund, owner donation, old-baseline padding, test/oracle weakening, or forecast-only discount.
title: (OPT) Replace weighted closure and closed-map B-trees with directly prepaid ordered storage
